source.excerpt: Shared as an all-season fantasy football advisor with quick verdicts.

body:
## What it does

Keeps up with the articles, ranking lists and chatter that move a fantasy roster, then answers the questions you actually have on a Sunday morning: who to start, which waiver claim to spend on, whether an injury matters and whether a trade offer is fair. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @notswizz shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
